prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Columbus. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean Columbus, Ohio (or a different Columbus)? Also let me know which kind of tanning you want — UV tanning beds/booths, spray (airbrush or automated), or both — and whether you prefer a budget place, a high-end salon, or a chain with many locations. With that I can give a short list of specific salons to call and why each would fit your needs.

While you reply, here are helpful things to consider and ask when you call any salon (so you can compare options):

- Type of service available: stand-up booth, lay-down bed, high-pressure vs. low-pressure lamps, or spray tan (airbrush vs. automated).
- Lamp age and maintenance schedule (newer lamps mean faster, more even results).
- Session times and recommended frequency for your skin type (ask staff to skin-type evaluate you).
- UV spectrum and equipment: high-pressure beds give more UVA, less burning; low-pressure give more UVB.
- Pricing and packages (single sessions, multi-session packages, memberships) and any first-time specials.
- Safety procedures: sanitation between clients, eye protection provided, staff training/certification.
- Staff qualifications and whether they perform a skin assessment / provide written tanning plan.
- Wait times and appointment vs. walk-in policy.
- Spray-tan specifics (type of DHA used, sample chart for shade, how long before showering, odor control).
- Cancellation and refund policy for packages.
- Any specials for students/military and promotions.

If you confirm the city and your preferences I’ll give 4–6 specific salons with reasons to call each (location, equipment strengths, price tier, specialties, and what to ask them). I can also include estimated phone numbers and addresses if you want.
